cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.31.5.0)
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "C:/Users/ksj10/.pico-sdk/sdk/2.2.0/cmake")
cmake_policy(SET CMP0126 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0128 OLD)
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE C)
set_property(DIRECTORY PROPERTY INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "")
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "-mcpu=cortex-m33 -mthumb -march=armv8-m.main+fp+dsp -mfloat-abi=softfp -mcmse")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG "-Og -g")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
add_definitions([==[-v]==])
cmake_policy(SET CMP0065 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0155 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0157 OLD)
include("${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/HeaderpadWorkaround.cmake")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "C:/Users/ksj10/Desktop/_0_programs/_3_GIT_REPO/__PRIVATE/_36_RPI_PICO_2/_1_REPO_1_PICO_2_W/blink/build_repro/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-7synas")
add_executable(cmTC_7da77)
target_sources(cmTC_7da77 PRIVATE
  "C:/Users/ksj10/.pico-sdk/cmake/v3.31.5/share/cmake-3.31/Modules/CMakeCCompilerABI.c"
)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmTC_7da77_loc"
     CONTENT $<TARGET_FILE:cmTC_7da77>)
set_property(TARGET cmTC_7da77 PROPERTY "C_STANDARD" "11")
target_link_libraries(cmTC_7da77 ${LINK_LIBRARIES})
